newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Daya Sakti sees 1997 net at 18 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Daya Sakti sees 1997 net at 18 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian small-capitalised timber firm PT Daya Sakti Unggul Corporation said on Thursday it expected to post a net profit of 18 billion rupiah in 1997, against 9.0 billion rupiah in 1996.
Daya Sakti said it expected to post a net profit of around 29 billion rupiah next year.

"The net profit for 1997 is expected to reach around 18 billion rupiah. Next year (the net profit) is likely to be some 29 billion rupiah," president-director Nyoto Suhardjojo told reporters after a company shareholders' meeting.

Daya Sakti corporate secretary Bonifasius said the company did not expect any sharp increases in the prices of its forestry products, including plywood, and that its profitability in the next two years would come mainly from increased production efficiency.
He said the firm planned to install equipment costing around 17 billion rupiah in August which would increase efficiency.
The company did not give further details.
Daya Sakti posted net sales of 214.5 billion rupiah in 1996 against 175.2 billion rupiah in 1995.
Total assets were 190.88 billion rupiah in 1996 against 171.09 billion rupiah in 1995.
